src/base.css.name: Colors, fonts and layout
src/base.css.description: Sets the look of every screen: the colors in light and dark mode, the fonts, buttons, the how-to lines, confetti and the small-phone sizes.

src/extra.css.name: Choices, board and end-of-game look
src/extra.css.description: Styles the welcome choices, the header's language switch and theme toggle, the credits line, the board and its rings, the coach's box, the handshake and the grey rainy loss screen.

src/page.template.html.name: Page skeleton
src/page.template.html.description: The empty page the pieces are poured into: the title, icon and fonts, the saved theme, the header, the panel and the credits line.
